sensitivity_analysis.interpretation: Rank sensitivity under the listed perturbations is not a probability of analog validity. Distances from different descriptor subsets use different averaging dimensions.

quality_scenarios.reason: The LOLA strip warning and MOLA direct-observation counts cannot be converted into per-cell elevation uncertainty from the current inputs; no numeric quality perturbation is justified.

reference.product: NASA LRO LOLA GDR LDEM_4 V3.0
reference.effective_resolution: Not established by the native grid spacing or the 20 km output grid.
reference.coverage_note: Finite output cells do not distinguish direct observations from interpolated source cells.
reference.registration: Ascending cell-centered latitude and east-positive longitude; local sampling uses a spherical body radius.
warnings: LOLA LDEM_4 label notes possible artifacts at 45-degree latitude strip boundaries; this is not an observed artifact diagnosis.
This regional window intersects the nominal 45 S strip boundary; verify seam behavior with independent data before interpreting the ranking.

seam_inspection.conclusion: Adjacent-row differences alone cannot distinguish topography from a processing seam; quality remains unresolved.

earth.effective_resolution: Varies with the source survey and composite; not established at 1 arc-minute everywhere.
earth.quality_layer_status: Source-by-source observation quality and uncertainty are not mapped to the regional samples.
warnings: ETOPO1 combines different land and ocean source surveys; identical grid spacing does not imply identical effective terrain detail.
Earth mean-sea-level, lunar reference-sphere, and Martian areoid heights are not directly compared as absolute elevations.

header.title: NASA/POWER Source Native Resolution Climatology Climatologies
header.range: 25-year Meteorological and Solar Monthly & Annual Climatologies (January 2001 - December 2025)

winner_climate.usage: Earth context only; excluded from cross-body topographic distance.

limitations: Exploratory topographic ranking within seven preselected terrestrial windows; not a global discovery or validated analog classification.
All rasters are bilinearly sampled and averaged over 20 km cells on a spherical local grid; fine craters and rover-scale terrain are unresolved.
Distances use three correlated relief descriptors with equal contribution. This transparent baseline is not scientifically calibrated.
Elevation datums differ. Absolute mean elevation is displayed for context and excluded from the distance.
No inference about geology, mineralogy, atmospheric equivalence, habitability or mission safety is supported.
Raster interpolation and differing native resolution introduce uncertainty; no formal confidence interval is estimated.
